data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hogos', meaning 'learner' or 'wise'. In the Christian tradition, the name Hogue is associated with the wisdom and knowledge found in scripture and spiritual teachings. The name Hogue carries the meaning “Learned, Wise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hogue usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
